reason: A DSH Web dashboard plugin that visualizes session token usage, context pressure, estimated costs, per-round metrics, and optional DeepSeek account balance information.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供实时 Token 用量、上下文压力、成本估算、逐轮图表和可选 DeepSeek 账户余额展示。
summaries.en: A DSH Web dashboard that displays real-time token usage, context pressure, estimated costs, per-round charts, and optional DeepSeek account balance information.

capabilities: Displays real-time token usage and context metrics
Calculates estimated model costs in CNY and USD
Renders per-round usage and cost charts
Queries DeepSeek account balance through a host-side API proxy
Reads configured pricing and currency settings
